name: Flat pizza
summary: Whole flat pizza on a wooden board with pepperoni and herbs, one slice pulled out with cheese. For takeaway scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the board rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the pizza is about 520 px wide; use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = slight rock, pop = scale in
